vtt:
WEBVTT

00:00:20.000 --> 00:00:57.000
<v Priya Nair>Lakeshore Foods says SO 104527 arrived short two bags.</v>

00:00:57.000 --> 00:01:34.000
<v Sam Okafor>I'll check the packing list for SO 104527 today.</v>

00:01:34.000 --> 00:02:11.000
<v Priya Nair>Raj, can you message Lakeshore Foods on Teams that we're on it?</v>

00:02:11.000 --> 00:02:48.000
<v Raj Mehta>On it.</v>

00:02:48.000 --> 00:03:25.000
<v Priya Nair>Northfield Bakery asked for the bill of lading for SO 104511.</v>

00:03:25.000 --> 00:04:02.000
<v Priya Nair>I'll send the bill of lading for SO 104511 to Northfield Bakery.</v>

00:04:02.000 --> 00:04:39.000
<v Sam Okafor>Is the second truck still at risk?</v>

00:04:39.000 --> 00:05:16.000
<v Priya Nair>Probably fine.</v>
